description: This file defines the LoyaltyProgram class and several functions related to managing loyalty points, loyalty program details, and redemption logic within an ERP system, specifically for the 'Loyalty Program' doctype in ERPNext.

classes.name: LoyaltyProgram
classes.description: Represents a Loyalty Program document in ERPNext, inheriting from frappe.model.document.Document.

methods.name: get_loyalty_details
methods.description: Fetches total loyalty points and total spent for a customer within a loyalty program, optionally filtered by expiry date and company.

methods.name: get_loyalty_program_details_with_points
methods.description: Retrieves detailed loyalty program info along with the customer's loyalty points, including tier level based on total spent.

methods.name: get_loyalty_program_details
methods.description: Gets loyalty program details for a customer, including program name and attributes, with silent option for non-enrolled customers.

methods.name: get_redeemption_factor
methods.description: Returns the conversion factor for loyalty points to currency for a given loyalty program.

methods.name: validate_loyalty_points
methods.description: Validates and processes loyalty points redemption for a document, ensuring points are sufficient and applying redemption details.
